Enums

enum mesh_msg_send_cause_t

Synchronized return value when sending a mesh message.

Values:

enumerator MESH_MSG_SEND_CAUSE_SUCCESS

The access msg is successfully processed by the stack.

enumerator MESH_MSG_SEND_CAUSE_INVALID_ACCESS_OPCODE

The access msg shall be formatted with a valid access opcode as defined in the Spec.

enumerator MESH_MSG_SEND_CAUSE_INVALID_ELEMENT

The model send the access msg with an invalid element index. It maybe due to the model is unregistered.

enumerator MESH_MSG_SEND_CAUSE_INVALID_MODEL

The model send the access msg with an invalid model index. It maybe due to the model is unregistered.

enumerator MESH_MSG_SEND_CAUSE_NODE_UNPROVISIONED

Unprovisioned devices cannot send access messages.

enumerator MESH_MSG_SEND_CAUSE_INVALID_SRC

The app may send an access msg without a model, so it need appoint the src itself. In this case, the stack will check the validity of the src address.

enumerator MESH_MSG_SEND_CAUSE_INVALID_DST

The dst address is assigned by the application. The stack will check the validity of the dst address.

  1. The dst addr cannot be the unassigned address.

  2. When the message is encrypted by the device key, the device key shall exist.

enumerator MESH_MSG_SEND_CAUSE_PAYLOAD_SIZE_EXCEED

Depending on the msg size, the access msg is sent by unsegmented or segmented. The maximum size of the access PDU is ACCESS_PAYLOAD_MAX_SIZE.

enumerator MESH_MSG_SEND_CAUSE_PAYLOAD_SIZE_EXCEED1

If the SZMIC bit is set to 0, the TransMIC is a 32-bit value. If the SZMIC bit is set to 1, the TransMIC is a 64-bit value. When the SZMIC bit is set to 1, the maximum payload size of segmented access PDU has to minus 4.

enumerator MESH_MSG_SEND_CAUSE_INVALID_VIR_ADDR

The virtual address is invalid.

enumerator MESH_MSG_SEND_CAUSE_INVALID_APP_KEY_INDEX

The index exceeds the upper limit mesh_node.app_key_num.

enumerator MESH_MSG_SEND_CAUSE_INVALID_APP_KEY_STATE

The key hasn't been added.

enumerator MESH_MSG_SEND_CAUSE_APP_KEY_NOT_BOUND_TO_MODEL

The key hasn't been bound to the model when sending the msg with model.

enumerator MESH_MSG_SEND_CAUSE_INVALID_NET_KEY_INDEX

The index exceeds the upper limit mesh_node.net_key_num.

enumerator MESH_MSG_SEND_CAUSE_INVALID_NET_KEY_STATE

The key hasn't been added.

enumerator MESH_MSG_SEND_CAUSE_NO_BUFFER_AVAILABLE

The mesh msg is sent via the advertising channel, taking up resources and time. When resources are exhausted currently, the msg can't be sent.

enumerator MESH_MSG_SEND_CAUSE_NO_MEMORY

The heap space is exhausted which need be allocated in some cases.

enumerator MESH_MSG_SEND_CAUSE_TRANS_TX_BUSY

The segmented msg need to be buffered at the transport layer for retransmission. Buffer size at the transport layer is limited so that a new segmented msg can't be sent if the buffer is full.

enumerator MESH_MSG_SEND_CAUSE_INVALID_ACCESS_PARAMETER

Invalid access parameters provided.

enum _mesh_msg_send_stat_t

Asynchronous callback value after sending a mesh message.

Values:

enumerator MESH_MSG_SEND_STAT_FAIL

Message sending failed.

enumerator MESH_MSG_SEND_STAT_SENT

Unsegmented access message sent.

enumerator MESH_MSG_SEND_STAT_ACKED

Segmented access message acknowledged.

enumerator MESH_MSG_SEND_STAT_ACKED_CANCEL

Acknowledged message ack == 0.

enumerator MESH_MSG_SEND_STAT_ACKED_OBO

Segmented access message acknowledged by FN.

enumerator MESH_MSG_SEND_STAT_ACKED_OBO_CANCEL

Acknowledged on-behalf-of message ack == 0.

enumerator MESH_MSG_SEND_STAT_TIMEOUT

Segmented access message timed out.

enumerator MESH_MSG_SEND_STAT_CANCEL

Seg message canceled by myself due to reasons like sequence running out etc.
